Hyvatia is Spacetrek Collective's first detection array built at Sundermere to monitor and stabilize the Reactor Drive's energy state in real time.

The Research Institute implanted the Exostrider's space-time error correction module runtime into Hyvatia's core, allowing Hyvatia to adjust the Exostrider's orbit and detect hidden spaceborne threats with high precision. Therefore, Hyvatia possesses sufficient computational power to predict the Reactor Drive's rotation.

Hyvatia's core function is to detect abnormal or dangerous energy fluctuations, perform immediate emergency calibrations, and feed this data back to the Drive to ensure stable operation.
Hyvatia
Enemy: Hyvatia
New Enemies

After the Reactor Drive was set above Lahai-Roi by the Exostrider, it remained on high alert to the activities of Aleph-1. 

When the Drive's immune response is triggered, a mechanized "Reactor Husk" will arise from the depths of the energy well, with the sole purpose of eliminating intruders at all costs.

Research by Spacetrek Collective shows that Reactor Husk was once part of the Exostrider. Both share a mission to resist the Threnodian threat and safeguard civilization.

The Swift Dog is one of the common domestic dogs in families around the world, belonging to the Canidae Canis genus. It has a pointed snout, a flat forehead. The ears are high, the tail is curled up. The coat is black and yellow, the hair is coarse, and it is easy to keep clean. It has a gentle temperament, is easy to raise, and has a high degree of loyalty. It is also known as the "Four-eyed Earth Dog" in the folk. The Swift Dog is lively and cute, agile, with bright eyes, and the ears often turn with the sound.
Swift Dog

The Bulldog is one of the common domestic dogs in families around the world, belonging to the Canidae Canis genus. It has a pointed snout and a flat forehead. Its ears are high and its tail is curled upwards. Its fur is primarily yellow or brown, and the texture is coarse, making it easy to keep clean. It has a relatively gentle temperament, is easy to raise, and has a high degree of loyalty. Bulldogs are lively and adorable, with agile movements. Their eyes are spirited, and their ears often rotate with the sound.

The Green Rabbit is a subordinate of the mammalian rabbit family Rabbitidae, and is similar to both males and females. It is small in size, with long tubular ears, short forelimbs and strong hind legs much longer than the forelimbs, greenish in color, with a Tacetite tail and a special decapitated ecology. Widespread, mostly found in plains, hills and woodlands.
Green Rabbit

The Bajorn sheep is a large herbivore belonging to the genus Bovidae, with a pair of huge horns, the tips of which are curved backward and the roots are covered with Tacetite, the lips are black, the lower jaw is white, and the body is brown. Bajorn sheep has a pair of huge horns, the tips of which are curved backward and the roots are covered with Tacetite. it has black lips, white under the jaws, brown body, huge white spots on the back, and a small amount of Tacetite at the neck. it is widely distributed in mountainous areas, and it is good at walking on steep slopes. it mainly feeds on mossy plants and small herbs.

The Gray Ridge Bull is a large herbivore belonging to the genus Bovidae. The body is stout, with a prominent bulge at the shoulder, and sparse hair, mostly gray-brown; both males and females have horns, which are short and curved inward, and covered with Tacetite. It is widely distributed in the open areas of the plains, feeding mainly on weeds and herbaceous plants beside rivers.
Gray Ridge Bull
Huanglong
Animals

The Morri Cow is a large herbivore belonging to the genus Bovidae, which was domesticated by humans before the Lament and left behind in the forest after the Lament when humans gradually abandoned the Dim Forest. The Lament was originally a herbivore, but in order to adapt to the ecology of the Wuthering Waves, it began to eat Mutant Flora and its fruits, and over time the body of the Forest Cow became deformed.
Morri Cow
Huanglong
Animals

The Frostwing is a small bird that inhabits Tacet Field and belongs to the genus Pigeon in the family Hatydidae. The body is pure white, the tail is black and covered with Tacetite, the beak is purple, the wax membrane is magenta, and the feet and toes are bright red. It is very gregarious and often nests in groups, gathering in the stronger areas of Wuthering Waves and is widely distributed in the area around Tacet Field.
Frostwing
Huanglong
Bird

The Silver-Banded Lizard is a reptile belonging to the lizard family of the order Reptilia. It has short limbs, is agile, has leathery scales covering its body, and has black and white rings arranged on its entire body, with the white rings being narrower. It prefers a humid environment and is widely distributed on land around the world.
Silver-Banded Lizard
Huanglong
Reptile

The Azure Lizard is a reptile belonging to the lizard family of the order Reptilia. It has short limbs, is agile, has leathery scales on its body, is blue in color, and has fleshy spines on its back. The Azure Lizard prefers moist environments, and is widely distributed in waterfronts and wetlands around the world.\nThe Azure Lizard has a strong ability to adapt to the environment and reproduce on its own, which is why it is the most abundant among the three species of lizards.
Azure Lizard

It prefers moist environments and is widely distributed in waterfronts and wetlands around the world.\nThe Green Pit Lizard is slightly less adaptable than the Silver-Banded Lizard, and its reproductive ability is intermediate. It is mostly found in the wild in waterside vegetation areas and along the water's edge of towns and cities.

The Black-Striped Frog is an amphibian belonging to the family Chordata, class Amphibia, order Noctuidae. It has short limbs, green body with a lot of patterns; white abdomen, slightly bulging eardrums on both sides of the head, smooth skin with warts, and a small amount of Tacetite precipitated on the back. Widely distributed in rivers, lakes, wetlands and other environments, mainly in the grass at the water's edge.
Black-Striped Frog
Huanglong

It has short limbs, golden yellow body with a lot of patterns; white abdomen, slightly bulging eardrums on both sides of the head, smooth skin with warts, and a small amount of Tacetite precipitated on the back. It is widely distributed in rivers, lakes, wetlands and other environments, and is mainly active in grassy areas near water.\nThe golden-colored species is rarer and less abundant than the bright green variety, and the frog's population has declined due to habitat contamination.

The Phoenix Butterfly is a large species of the Papilionidae family, similar in size to a butterfly. It has a curved, golden-green band on each of its forewings, a few golden patches in the center of its hindwings, a crescent-shaped golden patch on the hind edge, and a long, slender, tail-like protrusion on its hindwings, the end of which is golden. It is often active in areas of dense vegetation in lush forests or other environments, flying in pairs in the high sky, feeding on nectar, and is not easily captured.\nDue to its high reproductive capacity and strong adaptability to its environment, it is the most common of the three types of butterflies.
Phoenix Butterfly
Huanglong
Insect

The Red Feather Butterfly belongs to the Papilionidae family, a large type of swallowtail butterfly, similar in size to a butterfly. The fore and hind wings are red, the veins are black, the wing edges have a few red spots, and the wing base has a small amount of Tacetite. They are often active in the dense vegetation of lush forests or other environments, flying in pairs in the high sky, feeding on nectar, and are not easily captured.\nThe Red Feather Butterfly is not as adaptable to the environment as the Phoenix Butterfly, and the population is greatly affected by changes in the environment and climate. Therefore, both its quantity and rarity are in a moderate position among the three types of butterflies.
Red Feather Butterfly
Huanglong
Insect

The Blue Feather Butterfly belongs to the family Papilionidae and the genus Papilio. It is a large swallowtail butterfly, similar in size to a butterfly. The fore and hind wings are red, the veins are black, and there are a few blue spots on the edge of the wings, and a small amount of Tacetite at the base of the wings. It is often active in the dense vegetation of lush forests or other environments, flying in pairs in the high sky, feeding on nectar, and is not easy to catch. The majority of Blue Feather Butterflies are male, and the number of females is scarce, resulting in a low reproductive capacity. Therefore, the Blue Feather Butterfly is the rarest and the number is the least among the three types of butterflies.
Blue Feather Butterfly

Insect

Chrysopa belongs to the order Neuroptera and the family Chrysopidae, with a slender body shape, and the body and wing veins are generally green. It has a chewing mouthpart, slender antennae, and is linear. The compound eyes are developed and have a metallic luster. It has two pairs of wings, the membrane is transparent, the veins are thin and often net-like, like a leaf, hence the name Chrysopa. Chrysopa mainly feeds on small insects and is a natural enemy of many pests. It is a natural enemy insect with great application value in the biological control of pests. It is widely distributed in forests, mountains, and plateaus around the world, and will appear in areas with dense vegetation.
Chrysopa

Tealfrill is a small bird with a teal body, belonging to the pigeon family. The body is teal, with a purplish-blue metallic sheen to the feathers, especially the wings, which are adorned with Tacetite. The iris is dark red, the beak is dark grey, and the toes are red. It is highly gregarious and is widely distributed in forests and ruins.

Due to the long-term consumption of the fruits of the mutated trees, a circle of Tacetite has grown on the neck. Due to the erosion, the living habits have also changed, and they are accustomed to gathering in places with stronger Wuthering Waves, and are widely distributed in major towns around the world.
Eveflitter

The Gray Crested Gull is a large hooked-billed seabird, belonging to the order of gulls in the class of birds. The whole body is light brown, with white wing spots on the wings, and a small amount of Tacetite; the beak is black, the feathers are dark brown, and the neck and above are gray. There are many different species of the same family around the world, and they are widely distributed in the marine areas of the world.
Gray Crested Gull

The Snow Crane is a large wading bird, belonging to the crane genus of the crane family. They are widely distributed in wetland environments.
Snow Crane

Every brick and tile in the Censure Court is made of modular parts. It is both an elegant garden and a prison for holding and purging Tacet Discords.
Within the Censure Court, there is a type of scout Autopuppet specialized in investigation and patrol. It usually conceals itself in the form of door rings, relief sculptures, and the like, surveying within the Censure Court. At critical moments, it transforms into an Autopuppet and reaches corners that larger Autopuppets cannot to fulfill its duty.

Deep within the Skyworks, the Myriad Snare serves as a living prison for Tacet Discords, capable of transforming into a formidable Autopuppet to wipe them out.
However, as the Skyworks fell into unknown chaos, all maintenance work came to a halt. Structures of the Myriad Snare damaged in fierce battle have all plunged into the abyss.
To this day, even with only a shattered body remaining, it still carries out its purge without rest.

The max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on Thousand-Puppet Pavilion is increased by 2.
